info.name: Claims API
info.description:
Manages the submission, tracking, and reconciliation of insurance claims to BPJS Kesehatan (Indonesia's national health insurance). This is a Siloam-internal API that abstracts the BPJS integration layer, normalising their external API into Siloam's internal standards.

Contact Support:  
Name: Siloam Insurance Integration Team  
Email: [insurance-integration@siloamhospitals.com](https://mailto:insurance-integration@siloamhospitals.com)
